analysis.one_line_summary: A creator demonstrates achieving a 90s Rachel Green layered blowout in under 5 minutes using a thermal round brush.
analysis.full_description: The video starts with the creator pointing to an image overlay of Jennifer Aniston as Rachel Green from Friends, hooked with the text 'Rachel Green Hair In under 5 mins'. She then shows the pink and bronze thermal round brush (Blowout Boost) and demonstrates rolling her face-framing front layers and side layers inward to achieve bouncy, flipped-under volume. The video concludes with her fluffing her hair and admiring the styled, voluminous final look to a trending remix of 'I'm Every Woman'.
